meals.name: The OG Girl Dinner
meals.description: Bread, butter, sharp cheese, grapes, and pickles. The medieval peasant plate that started it all.

ingredients.name: sharp cheddar or aged gouda, sliced

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Lay the 2 slices of sourdough on a wooden board. Slather them thickly with the 2 tablespoons of room temperature butter so it melts into the bread. Slice the 60g of sharp cheddar or aged gouda and lay it alongside the bread. Add a small bunch of red grapes and a few cornichons or dill pickles to fill the gaps. There are no rules here, just arrange by color and texture and enjoy the contrast of creamy butter, sharp cheese, and briny pickles.

meals.notes: The original Olivia Maher TikTok that started the whole trend. Use the best butter you can find because it matters here.

meals.name: Whipped Feta with Hot Honey and Walnuts
meals.description: Creamy, salty, sweet, and crunchy. Four textures in one bowl with zero cooking required.

steps.name: Whip
steps.text: Add the 150g of crumbled feta and 2 tablespoons of cream cheese to a food processor. Blend for a full 2 minutes, scraping down the sides halfway, until the mixture is completely smooth and fluffy. If it feels too stiff, add a tiny splash of water to loosen it.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Spoon the whipped feta into a shallow bowl and use the back of a spoon to create a deep swirl in the center. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of hot honey directly into the swirl. Scatter a handful of roughly chopped toasted walnuts over the top so they fall into the crevices. Serve immediately with crackers or crusty bread.

meals.notes: No food processor? Mash with a fork and beat vigorously. Less smooth but still excellent.

meals.name: Chilli Crisp Noodles with Soft-Boiled Egg
meals.description: Six minute noodles that taste like you ordered them from a really good spot.

ingredients.name: dried noodles (ramen, soba, or rice noodles)

steps.name: Soft boil egg
steps.text: Bring a small pot of water to a rolling boil. Gently lower the 1 large egg into the water and set a timer for exactly 6.5 minutes for a perfectly jammy yolk. Transfer the egg immediately to an ice water bath to stop the cooking process, then peel it under cold running water.

steps.name: Cook noodles
steps.text: Boil the 1 portion of dried noodles in the same pot according to the package until chewy. While they cook, whisk the 1.5 tbsp chilli crisp, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, and 1 tsp rice vinegar together in the bottom of your serving bowl.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Drain the noodles and add them directly to the sauce bowl. Toss vigorously with tongs until every strand is coated in the spicy oil. Halve the soft boiled egg and place it on top of the noodles, letting the yolk run slightly. Scatter the 2 thinly sliced spring onions over the top and eat right away while piping hot.

meals.notes: Fly By Jing chilli crisp is worth the upgrade over Lao Gan Ma. Add peanut butter for a satay vibe.

meals.name: Baked Feta Pasta
meals.description: The TikTok pasta that broke the internet. Roasted tomatoes, melted feta, done.

steps.name: Roast
steps.text: Preheat your oven to 400F/200C. Place the 200g of cherry tomatoes and 3 cloves of smashed, unpeeled garlic in the center of a baking dish. Nestle the 100g block of feta right in the middle. Pour 3 tablespoons of olive oil over the tomatoes and feta, and sprinkle with chilli flakes. Roast for 35 minutes until the tomatoes burst and release their juices, and the feta turns golden on top.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: While the feta roasts, boil the 100g of pasta in heavily salted water until al dente. Before draining, scoop out a full cup of the starchy pasta water and set it aside.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Remove the baking dish from the oven. Squeeze the soft roasted garlic out of its skins and mash it into the melted feta with a fork. Add the drained pasta and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Stir everything together vigorously until the cheese and tomato juices emulsify into a glossy, silky sauce. Top with a handful of torn fresh basil.

meals.notes: Use the best quality block feta you can find. Pre crumbled will not melt the same way.

meals.name: Cottage Cheese and Everything Bagel Plate
meals.description: Creamy cottage cheese, juicy tomatoes, and everything bagel seasoning make a savory plate with plenty of crunch.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Scoop the 1 cup of full fat cottage cheese into a wide, shallow bowl. Use the back of a spoon to create a deep divot in the center of the cheese. Pour a generous drizzle of good olive oil directly into the divot. Shower the top with 1 teaspoon of everything bagel seasoning so the seeds fall into the oil and cheese. Arrange a handful of halved cherry tomatoes around the edges and serve with crackers or cucumber slices for scooping.

meals.notes: Add chilli crisp instead of olive oil for a spicy upgrade. Trader Joe's Everything But The Bagel seasoning is the move.

meals.name: Tinned Sardines on Buttered Toast
meals.description: Briny, rich, and done in two minutes. The girl dinner for people with great taste.

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt, black pepper, hot sauce

steps.name: Toast and butter
steps.text: Toast the 2 slices of sourdough until they are deeply golden and crisp. While the bread is still piping hot, spread 1 tablespoon of salted butter generously over the surface so it melts deep into the crumbs.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Open the tin of sardines and lay them in a single layer over the buttered toast. Squeeze the juice of half a lemon directly over the fish. Add flaky sea salt, black pepper, and your favorite hot sauce. If you are using dijon mustard and sliced cornichons, smear the mustard on the bread before adding the sardines, and place the cornichons on top for a briny crunch.

meals.notes: Brand matters enormously. A good tin of sardines in olive oil is a completely different thing from the cheap supermarket version.

meals.description: Sweet peach, salty prosciutto, creamy burrata. Summer on a plate with no cooking required.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Place the 1 ball of fresh burrata in the center of a beautiful plate. Slice the 1 ripe peach and arrange the slices around the burrata. Drape the 3 slices of prosciutto di Parma over the peaches. Tuck a handful of fresh basil leaves into the gaps. Just before eating, tear the burrata open so the creamy center spills out. Finish with a drizzle of good olive oil, a swirl of balsamic glaze, and a pinch of flaky salt.

meals.notes: Tear the burrata open at the table so the cream spills out. Only works with ripe, in season peaches.

steps.name: Arrange

meals.description: Yes it is basic. Yes it is still perfect. The seasoning and chilli flakes make it.

steps.name: Toast

steps.name: Mash and top
steps.text: Halve the 1 large ripe avocado, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh directly onto the hot toast. Use a fork to mash it roughly right on the bread. Immediately squeeze fresh lemon or lime juice over the avocado to prevent browning. Shower with 1 teaspoon of everything bagel seasoning, a pinch of chilli flakes, and a sprinkle of flaky salt.

meals.notes: A fried or poached egg makes the toast more substantial. Pomegranate seeds add a tart pop and extra crunch.

meals.name: Hummus Plate with Warm Pita and Toppings
meals.description: A good hummus plate hits different when the pita is warm and the toppings are thoughtful.

steps.name: Warm pita
steps.text: Place the 1 pita bread directly over a gas flame or in a dry pan for about 30 seconds per side until it puffs up and gets charred in spots.

steps.name: Build the plate
steps.text: Spoon the 1/2 cup of hummus into a bowl and use the back of a spoon to create a deep swirl in the center. Drizzle generously with olive oil and dust with 1/4 teaspoon of smoked paprika. Arrange the halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and olives around the hummus. Tear the warm pita into wedges and serve alongside for dipping.

meals.name: Lazy Mac and Cheese
meals.description: Kraft in a pot, made correctly. Extra butter, black pepper, and no apologies.

ingredients.name: Kraft mac and cheese or Annie's
salted butter (more than the box says)
hot sauce, extra shredded cheese, breadcrumbs

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Boil the pasta from the 1 box of mac and cheese according to the package instructions. Drain the pasta, but leave about a tablespoon of the starchy cooking water in the pot to help the sauce bind.

steps.name: Make it better
steps.text: Return the pot to very low heat. Add 2 tablespoons of salted butter (more than the box recommends), the cheese powder, and just a small splash of whole milk. Stir vigorously until the butter and powder melt into a glossy sauce that coats every noodle. Finish with a very generous grinding of black pepper to cut the richness.

meals.notes: The secret is extra butter and less milk than the box says. Top with butter toasted breadcrumbs if you want to feel fancy.

meals.name: Grilled Cheese Dipped in Tomato Soup
meals.description: The ultimate comfort duo. Golden buttery bread, melted cheese, silky soup for dunking.

ingredients.name: American cheese or sharp cheddar, sliced
splash of cream stirred into soup

steps.name: Heat soup
steps.text: Pour the 1 can of tomato soup into a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir in a splash of cream if you want it extra rich. Keep it warm while you make the sandwich.

steps.name: Grill the cheese
steps.text: Spread the 2 tablespoons of softened butter evenly on the outside of both slices of bread. Place the 60g of sliced cheese between the unbuttered sides. Heat a pan over medium low heat. Cook the sandwich for 3 to 4 minutes per side, pressing down gently with a spatula, until both sides are deeply golden and the cheese is completely melted.

steps.name: Dip
steps.text: Cut the grilled cheese in half diagonally. Ladle the hot soup into a mug or bowl. Dunk the sandwich directly into the soup and eat immediately.

meals.notes: Medium low heat is the key to grilled cheese. Patience gives you an even golden crust without burnt bread.

meals.name: Butter Noodles with Parmesan and Black Pepper
meals.description: Cacio e pepe's lazy cousin. Butter, parmesan, pepper, done in 10 minutes.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: Boil the 100g of spaghetti in heavily salted water until al dente. Before draining, scoop out a large mug of the starchy pasta water and set it aside.

steps.name: Butter and toss
steps.text: Return the drained pasta to the pot off the heat. Add the 3 tablespoons of salted butter and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Toss vigorously with tongs until the butter emulsifies with the starch and coats every strand. Add the 40g of finely grated parmesan and more pasta water, tossing again until you have a silky sauce.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Finish with 1 teaspoon of coarsely ground black pepper and top with extra parmesan.

meals.notes: The pasta water is the secret. The starch helps the butter create a silky sauce that clings to the noodles.

meals.name: Scrambled Eggs with Cream Cheese and Chives
meals.description: Low and slow eggs with cream cheese folded in. The softest, richest scramble.

steps.name: Whisk
steps.text: Crack the 3 large eggs into a bowl and beat them thoroughly with a pinch of salt until completely uniform.

steps.name: Low and slow
steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon of salted butter in a small non stick pan over the absolute lowest heat. Pour in the eggs and stir constantly with a rubber spatula, scraping the bottom and sides to form soft curds. This should take 5 to 7 minutes. Do not rush it.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: When the eggs are just barely set and still look slightly wet, remove the pan from the heat. Fold in 1 tablespoon of cream cheese so it melts from the residual heat. Top with a small bunch of snipped fresh chives and black pepper.

meals.notes: Keep it low and slow and keep it moving. Taking it off the heat early is not optional.

meals.name: Loaded Baked Potato
meals.description: A whole meal in a potato skin. Sour cream, cheese, chives, the works.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Preheat your oven to 425F/220C. Rub the 1 large russet potato with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and a generous pinch of salt. Pierce it several times with a fork. Bake directly on the oven rack for 45 to 50 minutes until the skin is crispy and the inside is soft when squeezed.

steps.name: Load
steps.text: Split the potato open with a knife and push the ends together to puff up the fluffy inside. Add a pat of butter, then pile on 3 tablespoons of sour cream, 40g of shredded cheddar, a small bunch of chopped chives, and black pepper.

meals.notes: The key is rubbing with oil and salt and not wrapping in foil. Foil steams rather than bakes and ruins the skin.

steps.name: Brown the mushrooms
steps.text: Heat the butter and olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms in an even layer and leave them undisturbed for 3 to 4 minutes, until deeply browned underneath. Toss and cook for 2 minutes more.

steps.name: Add the aromatics
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium. Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Pour in the cream and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until it lightly coats the mushrooms.

steps.name: Cook ramen
steps.text: Cook the ramen according to package directions. In the last minute, add the bok choy to wilt.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Pour the ramen and broth into a bowl. Top with the crispy tofu, sesame oil, and garnishes.

meals.notes: Pressing the tofu is key to getting it crispy. Use a clean towel to squeeze the water out.

meals.name: Baked Sweet Potato with Black Beans and Salsa
meals.description: A soft baked sweet potato loaded with cumin-spiced black beans, salsa, and avocado makes an easy dinner for one.

steps.name: Bake potato
steps.text: Rub the sweet potato with oil and salt. Pierce with a fork. Bake at 425F/220C for 45-50 minutes until soft.

steps.name: Warm beans
steps.text: Warm the black beans with the cumin in a small pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir occasionally and add a spoonful of water if the pan looks dry.

steps.name: Load
steps.text: Split the potato open. Top with warm beans, salsa, and avocado slices.

meals.notes: The sweetness of the potato pairs perfectly with the savory, spicy beans.

meals.name: Cottage Cheese and Tomato Toast
meals.description: Cottage cheese spread on toast with sliced tomatoes and black pepper.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Spread the cottage cheese on the toast until the surface is golden and the edges are crisp. Move it to a plate while it is still hot.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Top with tomato slices.  Drizzle with olive oil and season.

meals.notes: Use a really good tomato for this. It makes all the difference.

meals.description: Cherry tomatoes and mozzarella balls on skewers, drizzled with pesto.

steps.name: Thread
steps.text: Thread the tomatoes and mozzarella balls onto small skewers.

steps.name: Dress
steps.text: Drizzle with pesto and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.

meals.notes: Keep the tomatoes and mozzarella close in size so the skewers are easy to eat and every bite feels balanced.

meals.name: Baked Apple with Oats
meals.description: A warm baked apple filled with oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and butter makes a single-serving crisp without the pan.

steps.name: Prep
steps.text: Core the apple, leaving the bottom intact. Place in a baking dish.

steps.name: Stuff and bake
steps.text: Mix oats, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Fill the apple with the mixture. Top with butter. Pour water into the bottom of the dish. Bake at 375F/190C for 30 minutes until soft.

meals.notes: This is like a deconstructed apple crisp. Serve with yogurt or ice cream.
